message.content: Hai! Maaf, saya tidak memiliki akses langsung ke inventaris barang. Untuk memastikan ketersediaan 1 lusin celana dalam ukuran L, silakan hubungi penjual atau cek platform penjualan yang Anda gunakan. Jika ada pertanyaan lain atau bantuan yang bisa saya berikan, beri tahu saja!
message.reasoning: The user writes in Indonesian: "Gan celana dalam 1 lusin ukuran L ready g gan..?". They are asking: "Gan, are there 1 dozen size L underwear ready?" They want to know if there's a dozen size L underwear ready. They might be asking for availability. We need to respond appropriately. The user is presumably a customer. We should ask clarifying question or provide info. We don't have inventory data. We can respond: "Maaf, saya tidak memiliki akses ke inventaris. Silakan hubungi penjual." But we can also ask if they want to place an order. We can respond politely. There's no function call needed. So just respond.
